description: Empty message has no MSH segment to read delimiters from (spec 005 Edge Cases, FR-006).
Message does not begin with the 3-character segment name MSH (spec 005 FR-006 condition 1, User Story 3 Acceptance Scenario 1).
MSH segment ends (at byte 6) before a complete 4-character MSH-2 is present -- only 2 of 4 encoding characters given (spec 005 FR-006 condition 2, User Story 3 Acceptance Scenario 2).

Well-formed MSH followed by a segment named '999', which fails spec 001's SEG grammar rule (alphabetic-led) at byte 13, segment index 1 (spec 005 FR-006 condition 3, User Story 3 Acceptance Scenario 3).
